help.title: PDFTools Help
help.description: A free PDF viewer and editor that works offline. Your documents never leave this device.

start.title: Opening files
start.body: Press Ctrl+O, drop PDF files on the window, or open a recent file from File → Recent. Each file opens in its own tab. Password-protected files ask for their password.

view.title: Viewing
view.body: Zoom with Ctrl+plus and Ctrl+minus or Ctrl+mouse wheel; Ctrl+0 fits the page and Ctrl+2 the width. Hold Space or press H to pan. The View tab has page layouts and rotation.

find.title: Finding text
find.body: Ctrl+F opens Quick Find; press Enter to search and F3 for the next hit. Ctrl+Shift+F opens Advanced Search, which also looks in comments, bookmarks and other open documents.

panes.title: Side panes
panes.body: The rail on the left opens Thumbnails, Bookmarks, Attachments, Layers, Signatures and Search. Esc returns to the rail.

forms.title: Forms
forms.body: Click a form field or press Tab to move through the fields. Ctrl+S saves the values. Home → Reset Form restores the defaults.

save.title: Saving
save.body: Ctrl+S adds your changes to the end of the file, so earlier signatures stay valid. Save As writes a copy; Save Optimized rewrites the file compactly. Unsaved work is kept on this device in case the browser closes.

print.title: Printing
print.body: Ctrl+P opens the print dialog: choose pages, size, markups and quality. Large drawings print sharpest through the browser's PDF viewer. File → Export Print-Ready PDF saves a copy with markups and form values burned in.

protect.title: Protected and signed files
protect.body: Protect → Security Info shows what a file allows. Signatures are checked on this device; the Signatures pane shows whether each signed part is unchanged.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: PDFTools makes no network requests with your documents. Error reports are sent only when you choose to, and you see every word of them first.

profile.title: Reviewer profile
profile.description: Your name is added as the author of the comments you make. The profile is kept on this device only.
profile.saveFailed: The profile couldn't be stored on this device. It is used until you close PDFTools.
profile.none: No profile yet. You'll be asked for one before your first comment; until then, comments are made as “Anonymous”.
profile.note: Your name becomes the author of new comments. Initials, discipline and company are used in stamps and comment review sheets.
